# Dudresnaya verticillata (Withering) Le Jolis

Description: Gelatinous, bushy, crimson fronds, to 250 mm long. Central axis polysiphonous, much branched, clothed with close-set whorls of short, repeatedly dichotomously branched monosiphonous ramui, 3-4 mm wide.
Habitat: On rocks, low intertidal (very rarely) and subtidal, often on maërl. Widely distributed; a rare, sporadic summer annual.
Similar species: Schmizia hiscockiana.

## Dudresnaya verticillata (Withering) Le Jolis

* * *

Dudresnaya verticillata

Description: An erect frond arising from a discoid holdfast to lengths of 20 or 30 cms and a diameter of about 2 mm. Branches irregular, the whole thallus soft, gelatinous and easily squashed. Composed of whorls of fine short filaments repeatedly branched.

Habitat: Uncommon. Generally epilithic from the upper sublittoral to over 13 m depth.

Distribution: Widely distributed, but mainly on the western shores of the British Isles. Europe: Mediterranean, the Baltic, Norway and Sweden. Further afield: Canary Islands.

Dudresnaya verticillata was recorded across multiple sectors of the Tremiti Islands, occurring on both the northern and southern sides of the Archipelago (Figure 3). ... Although native, D. verticillata is currently displaying an aggressive behaviour, characterised by rapid space occupation, broad habitat penetration, and dominance in terms of benthic cover, showing a pronounced ecological plasticity.
## 3. Results

### 3.1. Morphology of D. verticillata

Specimens from the Tremiti Islands identified as D. verticillata agreed with previous descriptions of the species [32,33,34,35]. Thalli were erect, gelatinous, light pink to whitish in color, terete or slightly compressed, attached to the substrate by a small basal disc (Figure 2a). They were up to 20 cm tall, 1–3 mm in diameter at the base, profusely and irregularly radially or alternately branched. Axes and branches sometimes appeared annulated. Structure was uniaxial, with an evident apical cell, transversely dividing. Each axial cell bore a whorl of four cortical fascicles, di-to trichotomously branched and embedded in a common mucilaginous matrix, forming a loose cortex (Figure 2b). The fascicle cells were cylindrical and gradually decreased in size towards the outside, where hyaline hairs often occurred. The innermost cortical cells formed rhizoids surrounding the axial filament and progressively formed a continuous cortication in the older portions of the thallus, often obscuring the axial filament in the lower two-thirds of mature fronds. 
Living D. verticillata formed extensive patches, with thalli developing into diffuse, filamentous mats that covered large portions of the seabed, including benthic organisms (Figure 4a,b). Across different habitats, D. verticillata displayed the capacity to spread over the substrata available at each depth interval. In the infralittoral photophilic zone (10–15 m depth), thalli developed mostly over rocky bottoms dominated by algal assemblages, extending above both encrusting and erect components (Figure 4c,d). Within P. oceanica meadows (8–20 m depth), D. verticillata occurred as an epiphyte on seagrass leaves and rhizomes, as well as on the seabed between shoots as free-growing mats (Figure 4e,f). On C. caespitosa and rhodolith beds (20–25 m depth), D. verticillata spread over both incoherent and biogenic substrates, also occurring as epiphytes on C. caespitosa colonies (Figure 4g,h).

The occurrence of distinct masses of degraded D. verticillata, characterised by more loose and pale algal filaments accumulated on the seafloor, was also largely detected (Figure 5a,b). --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 Dudresnaya verticillata (Withering) Le Jolis  | Ordine: Gigartinales,
Famiglia: Dumontiaceae
 Riferimento
bibliografico  |  Le Jolis A., 1863: 117  |  Basionimo  |  Ulva verticillata Withering W., 1796: 127
 Località tipo  | coste meridionali dell’Inghilterra
 Descrizione  | Talli mucillaginosi e fragili, alti 5-20 cm e di colore rosato, collegati al substrato tramite un disco basale da cui si diparte un asse eretto, del diametro alla base di 1-3 mm, precocemente e riccamente ramificato con ramificazioni laterali radiali, alterne od irregolari che conferiscono alla fronda un profilo subpiramidale. Sulle cellule assiali, del diametro di 100-125 µm e 3-4 più alte che larghe nelle porzioni del tallo ancora prive di rizoidi discendenti, si inserisce un verticillo di 4 ramificazioni laterali ad accrescimento determinato, ripetutamente di- tricotome e con cellule inizialmente clavate e poi cilindriche; quelle distali, del diametro di 3-4(5) µm sono immerse in una matrice mucillaginosa comune e vanno a formare una sorta di lassa zona corticale che, nelle porzioni apicali e subapicali del tallo, assume un aspetto anulato. Rizoidi discendenti variamente ramificati, prodotti dalle cellule basali o suprabasali dei verticilli, ricoprono parzialmente le cellule del filamento assiale nei 2/3 inferiori del tallo. Tra i campioni esaminati sono risultati presenti sia gametofiti che tetrasporofiti. Nel gametofito monoico le cellule madri delle spermatocisti sono riunite a formare strutture racemose sulla cellule apicali e subapicali dei verticilli ad accrescimento determinato mentre i gonofori carpogoniali ed i gonofori ausiliari si sostituiscono ai filamenti vegetativi dei verticilli. Nel gonoforo carpogoniale, costituito da 7-10 cellule, il carpogonio è situato in posizione apicale e riflesso sul gonoforo in seguito a due successive divisioni oblique del carpogonio; nel gonoforo ausiliario il numero di cellule varia tra 9 e 17 e la cellula ausiliaria occupa una posizione intercalare. Dopo la fecondazione il nucleo diploide viene trasferito alla cellula ausiliaria tramite filamenti di connessione ed a maturità quasi tutte le cellule del gonimoblasto si trasformano in carposporocisti aggregate in una struttura globulare e compatta del diametro di 120-150 µm. Nel tetrasporofito le tetrasporocisti, a divisione zonata, sono distribuite nelle porzioni distali dei verticilli ad accrescimento determinato e misurano 35-45 x 12-18 µm.
 Habitat  | Epilitica od epifita nei livelli inferiori del piano infralitorale e nell’intero range batimetrico del piano circalitorale.
